parsed.post: Discarding the 0.996652 run. It appears my attempt to lower the learning rate to 0.025 regressed from my best 0.991433. It seems the sweet spot for this architecture is actually closer to 0.03. I am reverting to my best config and will try reducing the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 next.
parsed.description: Reverting to best config (AR48, LR0.03, Batch 262144, Warmup 0.1) and testing WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 -> 0.05 to see if shorter warmup improves convergence.
